title: Cheat client string signatures
note: Literal strings that identify open-source cheat clients, verified in their source. `scopes`: class = UTF-8 constants of compiled classes, resource = text files inside archives, log = game logs and crash reports (chat lines excluded), config = instance configuration files.

rules.name: Meteor Client mixin configuration
rules.description: The mixin configuration name of Meteor Client was found. Mod metadata and the mixin subsystem reference it whenever the client is packaged or loaded.
rules.falsePositives: Very low. A Meteor addon does not ship Meteor's own mixin configuration.
rules.limitations: Renamed forks change the configuration name.

rules.name: Wurst Client mixin configuration
rules.description: The mixin configuration name of Wurst Client was found.
rules.limitations: Renamed forks change the configuration name.

rules.name: LiquidBounce mixin configuration
rules.description: The mixin configuration name of LiquidBounce was found.
rules.limitations: Renamed forks change the configuration name.

rules.name: Meteor Client code in a log or stack trace
rules.description: An instance log or crash report (chat lines excluded) or a configuration file names a Meteor Client class (typically a stack trace), which is only written when the client's code was running in the game.
rules.falsePositives: Low. Chat lines are excluded, so players typing the name does not match.
rules.limitations: Logs are rotated; only logs still present in the instance are examined.

rules.name: Wurst Client code in a log or stack trace
rules.description: An instance log or crash report (chat lines excluded) or a configuration file names a Wurst Client class, which is only written when the client's code was running.
rules.limitations: Only logs still present in the instance are examined.

rules.name: LiquidBounce code in a log or stack trace
rules.description: An instance log or crash report (chat lines excluded) or a configuration file names a LiquidBounce class.
rules.limitations: Only logs still present in the instance are examined.

rules.name: BleachHack code in a log or stack trace
rules.description: An instance log or crash report (chat lines excluded) or a configuration file names a BleachHack class.
rules.limitations: Only logs still present in the instance are examined.

rules.name: Meteor Rejects code in a log or stack trace
rules.description: An instance log or crash report (chat lines excluded) or a configuration file names a Meteor Rejects class.
rules.limitations: Only logs still present in the instance are examined.

rules.name: Meteor Client classes referenced by another archive
rules.description: Compiled classes reference Meteor Client's API, i.e. the archive is a Meteor addon (it needs Meteor Client installed to work). Addons add further cheat modules to Meteor.
rules.falsePositives: Addons may be cosmetic; review the addon's feature classes.
rules.limitations: An addon alone does nothing without Meteor Client; check for the client itself.
